definitions.explanation: The clipped form of {水曜日|すいようび}, used in schedules, timetables, and casual speech where the word is already understood to name a day of the week.

examples.japanese: {水曜|すいよう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{定休日|ていきゅうび}→定休日：09541_teikyuubi⟧です。
examples.english: Wednesday is our regular closing day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧{水曜|すいよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ごみ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}します→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: We put out the trash every Wednesday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水曜|すいよう}なら⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れ→取れる：02376_toreru⟧そうです。
examples.english: It looks like I can make time next Wednesday.

notes:
Shortened from ⟦{水曜日|すいようび}→水曜日：00672_suiyoubi⟧ by dropping {日|び}. The full form is the default in careful speech and writing; the short form appears where space is tight or the context is obvious.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧{水曜|すいよう}: every Wednesday
- {水曜|すいよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧: Wednesday night
- {水曜|すいよう}{定休|ていきゅう}: closed on Wednesdays
- {水曜|すいよう}⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧: released on Wednesdays

USAGE:
All seven days clip the same way (⟦{月曜|げつよう}→月曜：30298_getsuyou⟧, ⟦{火曜|かよう}→火曜：13459_kayou⟧, ⟦{木曜|もくよう}→木曜：03163_mokuyou⟧, {金曜|きんよう}, ⟦{土曜|どよう}→土曜：22529_doyou⟧, ⟦{日曜|にちよう}→日曜：22837_nichiyou⟧). Many shops and museums take their ⟦{定休日|ていきゅうび}→定休日：09541_teikyuubi⟧ on a Wednesday, so the word turns up often on signs and websites.
